author: Saraxx
body:
Dear Avicus staff,

I recently got temp banned for excessive infractions for a month. 

I would like to apologize to the Avicus staff for abusing /report as I didn't think I would be punished for what I was reporting. Personally, I think 1 month i really harsh considering most of my infractions have been mostly kicks and warns. Also the infraction given by HarryTheCarry about team griefing is false, as I was just trying to help my defense team and build my own stuff. If I get appealed I promise to not do things that will get me into trouble. I will ask other staff members if what I'm doing is okay before doing something.

Again, I am very sorry for the damage I have caused the Avicus community. As stated I feel a 1 month temp ban is very harsh, and I suggest maybe making the infraction expiry date sooner.

I am a very playful person, who likes to talk a lot to my friends and enjoy myself on the Avicus network. I usually spend most of my time on the game mode 'walls'. I admit I sometimes get too over excited, and get carried away which is why I have the infractions 'spamming' and 'caps'. All I want to do is play on this fantastic server with the community. I am not angry with the mods, but I am genuinely surprised about how long my ban is for.

I promise to calm down my act and I will try my best not to receive infractions. As I said I am a very playful person who gets excited very easily, but I'll try not to over step the mark next time. Again, I am very sorry I have caused trouble and promise not to do it again. Sorry for breaking the rules, I hope you will appeal me.

Yours sincerely,
Sara

title: My appeal

replies.author: Tazz
replies.body: You were banned for 30 days because you have 10 infractions in the last 8 months, therefore the infraction remains valid. I'm going to deny this for now and a senior can go over it.
